unit_label: BRBL::MOD_APPENDIX::U01: Separate payment-system authorisation,settlement and disputes

payload.title: Identify the system event and the responsible participant
payload.core_explanation_md:
The payment-system statute addresses authorisation and supervision, approved settlement arrangements, finality, disputes and specified contraventions. A failed customer transfer is not automatically the same legal event as a system-participant settlement obligation or a system-provider authorisation defect.

For a settlement problem, identify the applicable approved procedure and finality event. For a dispute or dishonour issue, read the specific actor, conditions and remedy. The appendix is a navigation aid; the full rule and system facts are needed before asserting that insolvency reverses a settlement or that every electronic failure is a statutory offence.

self_check.prompt_text: Why distinguish a customer failure from system settlement?
self_check.expected_takeaway: They can involve different obligations, actors and legal events.
